answer: At each dawn the registry seats new identities in willow rings of twelve strangers, each ring sealed by one willow planted at the gate bearing the twelve names. Rings are drawn by lot, so a farmer cannot seat its puppets together. Each member locks $30 of timber into the ring's shared pool; one proven fake forfeits the whole pool to the prover and the ring dissolves. A funding source may place one identity per ring, and its k-th identity locks k times $30, so forging 1,000 puppets costs $30 times (1+...+1000), $15,015,000. An honest user locks $30 once, refunded after a clean year.
